seo.title: Pump Sizing Calculator - Required Power
seo.description: Pump Sizing Calculator — Size a centrifugal pump by calculating required power from design flow, head, efficiency, and safety margin with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Required Power = ρQgh/(η) × safety. /1000 converts W to kW for the final answer. Safety factor typically 1.1-1.25.

content.introduction: Calculate the required motor power for a centrifugal pump given design flow, total head, efficiency, and a safety margin. Round up to the nearest standard motor size (5.5, 7.5, 11, 15, 18.5, 22, 30, 37, 45, 55, 75 kW).

example.description: 100 m³/h × 50m at 75% efficiency with 15% safety: 20.9 kW. Select a 22 kW standard motor.

faq.q: What safety factor should I use?
faq.a: 1.1-1.15 for well-defined systems with accurate pressure drop calcs; 1.2 for conservative estimates; 1.25+ for high-viscosity or uncertain conditions.
